news.summary: Microsoft Research released a new version of Aurora, a foundation model for weather and Earth-system applications, with additional variables and forecasting capabilities. This is particularly useful in fields such as weather forecasting, climate modeling, and energy management.

news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced an open-source visualization language called Flint, which lets AI agents create charts from compact, human-editable specifications. This aims to provide a balance between ease of use and expressiveness in chart creation.
